competences: The learner identify the order of two actions.
The learner use and punctuate before in source sentences.
languageCompetence: Pronounces, reads, spells and uses correctly: before, first action, second action, breakfast, homework.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to identify the order of two actions.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to use and punctuate before in source sentences.
priorKnowledge: Learners describe familiar sequences such as washing hands and eating food.
materials: Two-action sequence cards for homework/play and breakfast/prayer

steps.content: Learners describe familiar sequences such as washing hands and eating food. Key words: before, first action, second action, breakfast, homework
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher displays before sentence strips and links the chart to the prior knowledge: Learners describe familiar sequences such as washing hands and eating food. The teacher pronounces the lesson vocabulary, checks learners’ reading, and introduces using before.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall familiar words, read the displayed key words aloud, and explain what they already know about the topic.

source.quote: I wash my hands before eating food

steps.content: Using before: I wash my hands before eating food. First action: washing hands. Second action: eating food.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: I wash my hands before eating food. First action: washing hands. Second action: eating food. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "Complete the source sentence: I wash my hands ___ eating food." Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.
